text: Arthur was an inpatient in a mental health facility who was restricted to the residential ward. He frequently failed the monthly living-quarters evaluations and grew frustrated with the staff. He spent most of his days fantasizing about sweets and pastries. Several days before the upcoming inspection, Arthur's quarters were completely disorganized because he had spent the preceding days daydreaming instead of tidying up. Seeking to motivate him, the supervising nurse offered him a box of pastries from the local bakery if he sanitized and organized his quarters completely. Arthur was ecstatic. Unfortunately, there was insufficient time remaining before the inspection for him to complete the cleaning. Consequently, he failed the evaluation and did not receive the pastries. Arthur shouted in anger and kicked his closet door until the hinges bent, but the pastries were withheld.
